brief:
A judge threw out charges against Hiab Teshome, a University of Michigan graduate student and union leader, characterizing the prosecution as "political," Drop Site News reported. The dismissal occurred as Teshome's graduate student union navigates tense contract negotiations with the university over wages, benefits, and working conditions.

Teshome has held a prominent role in union organizing at Michigan while the labor dispute has intensified. The judge's decision to reject the charges removes a legal obstacle facing the student activist during a critical phase of labor talks between the union and the institution.
dek: The student, Hiab Teshome, is also a graduate student union leader in tense contract negotiations with the school.
title: Judge dismisses charges against pro-Palestinian Michigan student leader
